# Travel + Leisure Co. Recognized Among TIME’s World’s Best Companies for 2026


Sep 9, 2026 9:00am EDT


*Recognition highlights company’s continued focus on employee experience, business performance and responsible corporate practices*


ORLANDO, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Travel + Leisure Co.](https://www.travelandleisureco.com/) (NYSE: TNL), a leading leisure travel company, today announced that it has been named to **TIME’s World’s Best Companies 2026** list, recognizing 1,000 companies worldwide that demonstrate strong performance across employee satisfaction, revenue growth and sustainability transparency.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260909249820/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260909249820/en/)


Travel + Leisure Co. today announced that it has been named to TIME’s World’s Best Companies 2026 list, recognizing 1,000 companies worldwide that demonstrate strong performance across employee satisfaction, revenue growth and sustainability transparency.


Developed by TIME in partnership with Statista, the fourth annual World’s Best Companies ranking evaluates organizations across three key dimensions: **employee satisfaction, revenue growth and sustainability transparency** . The 2026 assessment includes an independent online survey of approximately 200,000 employees across more than 50 countries, together with analysis of company performance and sustainability-related data.


“We’re honored to be recognized by TIME as one of the World’s Best Companies for 2026. Our associates are at the center of everything we do, and their talent, commitment and execution are driving our continued success,” said Michael D. Brown, president and chief executive officer of Travel + Leisure Co. “As we advance our multi-brand strategy and grow our portfolio, we’re seeing the strength of our people and our brands come together to deliver strong results and exceptional experiences for our owners and members. We’re proud of the momentum we’ve built and remain focused on driving long-term growth and creating lasting value for our associates, owners, members and shareholders.”


Travel + Leisure Co. is a leading leisure travel company providing more than six million vacations to travelers around the world each year. The company operates a diverse portfolio of vacation ownership, travel club and lifestyle travel brands, including Club Wyndham, WorldMark, Margaritaville Vacation Club, Sports Illustrated Resorts, Accor Vacation Club, Eddie Bauer Adventure Club and RCI.


With hospitality and responsible tourism at its heart, Travel + Leisure’s more than 19,000 associates worldwide help fulfill the company’s mission to put the world on vacation. The company continues to invest in its brands, digital capabilities and employee experience while pursuing responsible growth and creating long-term value for owners, members, shareholders and communities.


For more information about Travel + Leisure Co., please visit[travelandleisureco.com](https://www.travelandleisureco.com/) .


To explore career growth and opportunities with our team, please visit[careers.travelandleisureco.com](https://careers.travelandleisureco.com/) .


**About Travel + Leisure Co.**


Travel + Leisure Co. (NYSE: TNL) is a leading leisure travel company, providing more than six million vacations to travelers around the world every year. The company operates a diverse portfolio of vacation ownership, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands designed to meet the needs of the modern leisure traveler, whether they’re traversing the globe or enjoying destinations closer to home. This includes experiential brands such as Sports Illustrated Resorts, Eddie Bauer Adventure Club, Margaritaville Vacation Club, and Accor Vacation Club, as well as cornerstone brands, Club Wyndham, WorldMark, and RCI. With hospitality and responsible tourism at its heart, the company’s more than 19,000 dedicated associates worldwide help fulfill its mission to put the world on vacation. Learn more at[travelandleisureco.com](https://www.travelandleisureco.com/) .
